note: T8 NFT companion. Product is attention: three non-spending commands, an advisor outside the tick, a journal, a personality. The only economic magnitude is idle_reduction_bps. Autopilot is a table of policy rows, not new code.

companion_rows_live.src: docs/BRIEF.md §2 T8 D1, PLAN_V11 G5, D-G-8
companion_rows_live.why: Lifted at G5 with a window-A recount. L143 now allows 1 only while T2 returns sit in the envelope; a flag without that witness is still a silent T2 shift

companion_revenue_live.src: docs/BRIEF.md §6 T8 D10, PLAN_V11 G6, D-G-9
companion_revenue_live.why: G6 closed the crane at zero. Lifting this flag would silence L128 on a pool tap; a share is a yield promise the protocol cannot hold

companion_carry_over.why: When the offline window ends the queue freezes. Carry would be a silent MSFT window extension

companion_calls_carry_over.why: Unused advisor calls do not stack. A burst on login would hide a rate-limit bypass

companion_replan_on_login.why: Catch-up applies recorded commands as recorded. Replanning backwards makes replay diverge

companion_commands_per_agent_per_tick.why: The tick reads one (seat, objective) pair per agent. A second command in the same tick is a no-op by construction

companion_advisor_queue_depth.why: One in-flight advisor request per holder. A second request while the first is live is COMPANION_QUEUE_FULL

demo_companion.why: Demo city has no wallet and no NFT, so no autopilot. Same isolation as DEMO_NO_CLAIM and DEMO_NO_PRIZE

companion_idle_relief_bps.src: docs/BRIEF.md §2 T8 D3, PLAN_V11 G5, D-G-8
companion_idle_relief_bps.why: Two idle quanta, same skeleton as Route. Cap is 10000 minus residual_idle so mul_remainder cannot zero the floor; not a new key and not a new code path

policy_kind.why: Autopilot is a pure function of recorded inputs. An LLM policy would put inference inside the tick

tie_break.why: Ties break on (priority_index, building_id, agent_id). Random would make equal inputs hash differently

hold_stale_action.why: Stale NFT hold turns the autopilot off. Fail-open would give the player more when the chain read dies

nft_proceeds_sink.why: NFT proceeds close the advisor inference bill first. The bill grows with holders; a pool share would promise yield

seat_agent.effect: reseat an already hired agent into an already built free slot
seat_agent.why: Reseat is instant and free. Not a build and not a hire, so it does not spend Capital

set_objective.effect: change the agent objective, effective next tick
set_objective.why: Objective swap costs only the row it selects. The companion does not pay Capital to flip a task

set_manager_focus.effect: set the manager contour focus, effective next tick
set_manager_focus.why: Manager focus picks a contour. No Capital and not a modifier row; live because Manager is live since G2

build.why: Building spends Capital. Autopilot must not grow the city while the holder is away

upgrade.why: Upgrade spends Capital and moves T2 payback. Companion does not buy growth

hire.why: Hire spends Capital and consumes a slot. Companion reseats, it does not recruit

fire.why: Fire has no refund. An away-from-keyboard fire is an irreversible loss of a paid slot

stake.why: Stake is a wallet act on a real stock token. Companion never touches the wallet

unstake.why: Unstake can freeze a district. Companion must not drop a holder's paper

deposit.why: Deposit mints Capital through the vault. Companion does not mint and does not touch the vault

withdraw.why: Withdraw is the bank exit. Companion must not move $CORP while the holder is away

buy_stock.why: Buying a stock token is a wallet swap. Companion has no DEX rights

sell_stock.why: Selling a stock token is a wallet swap. Companion has no DEX rights

claim_fragment.why: Claim spends a fragment requirement. An auto-claim would hide DEMO_NO_CLAIM and city-cap policy

claim_prize.why: Prize claim is a $CORP payout. Companion must not collect a seasonal prize unattended

research_start.why: Research spends Compute and Capital-priced nodes. Companion does not start a tree walk

open_district.why: Opening a district requires a live stake. Companion does not stake

respec_node.why: Respec is forbidden in v1 even for the player. Companion must not bypass exclusive pairs

output_bps.why: Direct output multiplier is paid fund dilution under section 2.5, forbidden by BRIEF section 2

offline_cap_hours.why: The only branch that sells time. Companion fills the window and must not lengthen it, even at zero

agent_slots.why: Slots are the same Automation branch. Companion reseats existing agents, it does not buy seats

fund_share_bps.why: Weight in proportional payroll: a companion share literally takes payout from everyone else

fragment_rate_bps.why: Selling real-paper fragment tempo for cash is pay-to-earn on the stock token

energy_cost_bps.why: Cheaper energy is the same as more output. a_l77_energy_relief already dragged net payback under 240

compute_cost_bps.why: Cheaper compute is the energy relief vector with a different name

build_cost_bps.why: Buying city growth speed with cash moves the T2 return bands

upgrade_speed_bps.why: Faster upgrades are the same growth purchase as a build-cost discount

xp_rate_bps.why: Buying progression speed is Handbook territory, not an NFT perk

population_conversion_bps.why: Retail conversion is the Consumer axis. Companion has no right to another district's key

jitter_bps.why: Narrower jitter is a real edge and belongs to the Steady trait

companion_idle.why: Only allowed companion key. Magnitude is companion_idle_relief_bps, not a second authored rate

closed_schedule.why: An agent on a closed schedule is idle by hours. Reseat into a built slot whose schedule is open

wrong_role.why: IDLE_WRONG_ROLE is a seating bug, not a resource shortage. Move the agent to a home-contour slot

drop_overclock.why: Projected energy deficit plus Overclock is idle-by-input. Drop Overclock so the tick can fire

restore_overclock.why: Energy surplus with reserve: restore Overclock. Companion does not invent a new energy number

logistics_idle.why: A logistician facing input idle flips Route or Stockpile. Magnitudes stay in modifiers.json

llm.advisor_calls_source: union of time.schedules open_hour and close_hour with efficiency_recalc_hour, hours taken modulo ticks_per_city_day

cost_usd_per_call_lo_8dec.why: Lower bound of the canon claim tens of dollars per ten thousand calls. Bounds of an assertion, not a measured provider price

cost_usd_per_call_hi_8dec.why: Exclusive upper bound of the same assertion. A point price waits on companion_llm_price_snapshot owned by T12

on_provider_fail.why: Provider failure substitutes a template. The economy does not notice. Code COMPANION_LLM_TEMPLATE

derived.advisor_calls_per_city_day: unique city hours among schedule open/close bounds union efficiency_recalc_hour
derived.commands_per_city_day_bound: ticks_per_city_day times slots_cap, an upper bound not a knob
derived.llm_calls_per_holder_city_day: equals advisor_calls_per_city_day; daily summary is city-wide not a holder cost
derived.llm_calls_at_10k_holders: advisor calls times BPS as the ten-thousand holder probe, not a stored 10000
derived.uptime_witness: minimalist, companion, optimizer; companion equals minimalist at zero magnitude
derived.command_counts: live allowed count and forbidden count
derived.forbidden_key_count: modifier keys minus allowed, must cover the rest with owner and why
